name: Day streak tracker
description: A white card on the clean background: a small spaced label and a big condensed title, then a row (or two) of day tiles. The finished days fill orange one after another with a white check that draws itself, the current day pops with a ring, and the days still to come stay as dashed outlines with a grey question mark that bobs in a wave; a mono counter like '1 / 7' and an optional short note sit underneath.
use_when: Habits, challenges and streaks: 'day 1 of trying this', 'I've done this for 5 days straight', 'first day is easy, let's see if it lasts', a 30-day challenge, a routine being tested.

title.help: what is being tracked, e.g. 'Focus hack' or 'No sugar'

kicker.help: small spaced label above the title

days.help: how many day tiles, 3-14 (up to 7 per row)

done.help: how many days are finished (0 to days)

future.help: mark on the days still to come; '' shows their numbers in grey

labels.help: optional short tile labels instead of 'DAY n', e.g. ['Mon', 'Tue', ...]; up to 4 characters each

note.help: short line under the counter, e.g. 'Day 2? Let's see.'; '' hides it
